verifier_findings: The parallel-block path bypasses the new toggle: it computes h = norm(x), calls self.mlp(h, fc=fc), and returns before either added cast. With parallel_block=True and coalescing='none', the MLP therefore still receives FP32 despite USE_BF16_MLP_NORM_OUTPUT=True. This misses the proposal's explicit requirement for consistent MLP-input boundary behavior across applicable Block.forward variants. Preserve the shared attention input when addressing this; coalesced projections also require explicit compatibility handling rather than silently ignoring the toggle.

The default serial and sandwich paths correctly cast only the MLP-input norm result to torch.bfloat16 with a dtype guard. The toggle, environment/CLI resolution, checkpoint persistence/restoration, and single added startup field are wired correctly for those paths.

The patch otherwise remains small and confined to train.py, preserves parameter shapes and the 1800-second/full-chip/seed-42 launch contract, and introduces no data, tokenizer, evaluation-procedure, optimizer, external-data, or pretrained initialization changes. Runtime gates are appropriately deferred.
